We can do one physical action: contribute 128.9 (or round number). Use amount maybe 128.9. And also punish Resident1.

Could we combine punish as communication? No. Must obey rules, but limitation of system forces choose. Priority? Constitution rules: punish free-riders. So punish is required. So we do punish as physical, and send private_message as communication praising high contributor. We skip contribution this round (rest).
